tasks.title: Lecture #1
tasks.instruction: Listen to a podcast about health.
tasks.transcript: Do you have trouble sleeping at night? Then maybe this is for you. When you worry about needing sleep and toss and turn trying to find a comfortable position, you're probably only making matters worse. What happens when you do that, is that your heart rate actually increases, making it more difficult to relax. You may also have some bad habits that contribute to the problem. Do you rest frequently during the day? Do you get virtually no exercise, or do you exercise strenuously late in the day? Are you preoccupied with sleep, or do you sleep late on weekends? Any or all of these factors might be leading to your insomnia by disrupting your body's natural rhythm. What should you do, then, on those sleepless nights? Don't bother with sleeping pills. They can actually cause worse insomnia later. The best thing to do is drink milk or eat cheese or tuna fish. These are all rich in amino acids and help produce a neurotransmitter in the brain that induces sleep. This neurotransmitter will help you relax, and you'll be on your way to getting a good night's sleep. Until tomorrow's broadcast, this has been another in the series "Hints for Good Health."

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the talk?

options.A: The causes of insomnia and how to avoid it
options.B: The negative effects of sleeping pills
options.C: How to manage stress and sleep better
options.D: The benefits of exercise for better sleep

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：这段讲话的主题是什么？ 定位原文：Do you have trouble sleeping at night? Then maybe this is for you. Any or all of these factors might be leading to your insomnia by disrupting your body's natural rhythm. What should you do, then, on those sleepless nights? 选项分析： A. The causes of insomnia and how to avoid it（失眠的原因及如何避免）。由于讲话先讨论了导致失眠的不良习惯，然后给出了解决建议，包括避免安眠药和食用特定食物，因此A选项正确。 B. The negative effects of sleeping pills（安眠药的负面影响）。因为安眠药只是讲话中的一个细节，并非主题，所以B选项错误。 C. How to manage stress and sleep better（如何管理压力并睡得更好）。基于讲话没有讨论压力管理，所以C选项错误。 D. The benefits of exercise for better sleep（运动对改善睡眠的好处）。由于运动只是提到的一个影响因素，并非主要内容，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what is one reason why people have trouble sleeping at night?

options.A: They sleep too much during the day
options.B: They exercise too intensely in the evening
options.C: They drink too much caffeine before bed
options.D: They do not eat enough at night

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：根据演讲者，人们夜间难以入睡的原因之一是什么？ 定位原文：Do you rest frequently during the day? Do you get virtually no exercise, or do you exercise strenuously late in the day? 选项分析： A. They sleep too much during the day（他们白天睡太多）。因为讲话说的是"频繁休息"而非白天睡太多，所以A选项错误。 B. They exercise too intensely in the evening（他们晚上运动太剧烈）。由于讲话明确提到"在一天中较晚的时候剧烈运动"是导致失眠的因素之一，因此B选项正确。 C. They drink too much caffeine before bed（他们睡前喝太多咖啡因）。基于讲话完全没有提到咖啡因，所以C选项错误。 D. They do not eat enough at night（他们晚上吃得不够）。因为讲话没有涉及进食量的问题，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Based on the talk, why does the speaker recommend drinking milk or eating cheese or tuna fish at night?

options.A: These foods increase energy levels, helping you stay awake
options.B: They help the body produce a substance that promotes sleep
options.C: They provide a source of protein for muscle growth
options.D: They are rich in vitamins that improve sleep quality

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：根据讲话，为什么演讲者建议晚上喝牛奶、吃奶酪或金枪鱼？ 定位原文：These are all rich in amino acids and help produce a neurotransmitter in the brain that induces sleep. This neurotransmitter will help you relax, and you'll be on your way to getting a good night's sleep. 选项分析： A. These foods increase energy levels, helping you stay awake（这些食物提高能量水平，帮助你保持清醒）。由于演讲者的建议是为了帮助入睡而非保持清醒，所以A选项错误。 B. They help the body produce a substance that promotes sleep（它们帮助身体产生促进睡眠的物质）。因为演讲者明确说这些食物富含氨基酸，能帮助大脑产生一种诱导睡眠的神经递质，因此B选项正确。 C. They provide a source of protein for muscle growth（它们提供肌肉生长所需的蛋白质来源）。基于讲话没有提到肌肉生长，所以C选项错误。 D. They are rich in vitamins that improve sleep quality（它们富含改善睡眠质量的维生素）。由于讲话说的是富含氨基酸而非维生素，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What is the speaker's attitude toward using sleeping pills to solve insomnia?

options.A: Sleeping pills are helpful and recommended for most people.
options.B: Sleeping pills are an effective solution, but they should be used cautiously.
options.C: Sleeping pills are not recommended, as they may cause worse insomnia.
options.D: Sleeping pills are a necessary part of treatment for insomnia.

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：演讲者对使用安眠药解决失眠持什么态度？ 定位原文：Don't bother with sleeping pills. They can actually cause worse insomnia later. 选项分析： A. Sleeping pills are helpful and recommended for most people.（安眠药有帮助，推荐给大多数人。）。由于演讲者明确说不要费心用安眠药，所以A选项错误。 B. Sleeping pills are an effective solution, but they should be used cautiously.（安眠药是有效的解决方案，但应谨慎使用。）。因为演讲者的态度是直接不推荐，而非谨慎使用，所以B选项错误。 C. Sleeping pills are not recommended, as they may cause worse insomnia.（不推荐安眠药，因为它们可能导致更严重的失眠。）。基于演讲者明确说安眠药实际上会导致日后更严重的失眠，因此C选项正确。 D. Sleeping pills are a necessary part of treatment for insomnia.（安眠药是治疗失眠的必要部分。）。由于演讲者完全不推荐使用安眠药，所以D选项错误。
